## Why
Verify the tracked-changes renderer implementation from #15 / PR #22 with break/revert evidence.

## Scope
Temporarily disable redline markup, capture the failure of `tests/export/test_docx_redline_golden.py::test_tracked_changes_present`, restore the behavior, and record the passing result.

## Non-Goals
No production behavior change is requested.

## Tasks
- [ ] Test `tests/export/test_docx_redline_golden.py::test_tracked_changes_present` in a temporary working tree with redline markup disabled, capture the failure, restore the behavior, and record the passing result.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `tests/export/test_docx_redline_golden.py::test_tracked_changes_present` has recorded failure evidence with redline markup disabled and a recorded passing result after restoration.

## Implementation Notes
Linked implementation: #15, merged as PR #22 (`a809f8233af927a967aa060ada6b6d64e2d23acb`; `src/doc_lineage/export/docx_redline.py` and `tests/export/test_docx_redline_golden.py`).

Relates to #15.
